stories.title: Token Schema and Validation Contract
stories.description: Define canonical bearer token schema (hashed_token_id, issued_at, expires_at, scope, status, rotation_parent_id) and a strict validation contract (signature, expiry, scope, revocation) reused across GPTReader and Azure Functions to ensure consistent enforcement.

stories.title: Core Token Lifecycle Engine
stories.description: Implement lifecycle engine covering secure issuance, expiration enforcement, rotation with atomic invalidation of prior tokens, and revocation with persistent lookup ensuring O(1) validation checks.

stories.title: Internal Token Management Interfaces
stories.description: Expose internal service interfaces (issue_token, validate_token, rotate_token, revoke_token) for use by GPTReader, Azure Functions, and pipeline services with strict contract adherence and no public surface exposure.

stories.title: GPTReader Lifecycle Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate token validation into GPTReader request pipeline enforcing expiration, revocation, and scope checks per request with fail-fast rejection and audit-safe error handling.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests covering issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, replay attack rejection, invalid token handling, and GPTReader enforcement paths.
